schema_version.description: Request contract version; must be 1 when present.

repository.description: Absolute path of the Git repository to query. Defaults to the caller's workspace root; never inferred from the tool cwd.

selector.description: Selector of the node to query, as search and other results print it: symbol:<path>#<qualified>:<kind>, file:<path>, or dir:<path>.

include_unresolved.description: Also list unresolved calls whose name has no indexed function, method, class, or struct definition (typically standard-library or prelude calls such as map_err or Ok). By default they are omitted and counted in result.hidden_unresolved.

limit.description: Cap on each result array, nested ones included (callees and the lists inside their entries); 1-500, default 50. Cut arrays are reported in truncation.
